question:
The following histogram shows the weekly wages of workers at a factory.

How many workers get wages of more than Rs. 200?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc9da935a7be5186b1df3caa48b7d86a89b38e0620f9f630fafa468520ff6a4e.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question:

The workers get wages of more than Rs. 200 = 20 + 50 + 15 = 85

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
